title: agenda.appointment.no_show v1
description: Emitted when an appointment transitions to no-show. Derived from the REAL producer alebrije-mod-agenda-ex EventPublisher.publish_appointment_noshow/1 (event_publisher.ex:50,65-73), invoked on the scheduled->noshow status change (appointments.ex:663). NOTE: the producer currently XADDs the legacy stream/event_type 'appointment.noshow' and emits a FLAT field map; on adoption it must wrap in this envelope (event_type const below) and move data fields under data.*. Source: alebrije-mod-agenda-ex (Elixir).

appointment_id.description: UUID of the appointment that went no-show. Producer stringifies appt.id (event_publisher.ex:67).

calendar_id.description: Calendar the appointment belongs to. Producer stringifies appt.calendar_id (event_publisher.ex:69).

contact_phone.description: E.164 contact phone on the appointment (event_publisher.ex:70).

status.description: Appointment status at emit time; 'noshow' for this event (event_publisher.ex:71).
